name: snapurl
description: SnapURL — short links, dynamic QR codes and cookieless analytics.

scripts.test:coverage: COVERAGE=1 pnpm build:packages && COVERAGE=1 pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.staging:smoke: API=http://localhost:3001/api/v1 RD=http://localhost:3002 DATABASE_URL=postgres://snapurl:snapurl@localhost:5435/snapurl bash scripts/smoke.sh && API=http://localhost:3001/api/v1 RD=http://localhost:3002 DATABASE_URL=postgres://snapurl:snapurl@localhost:5435/snapurl bash scripts/smoke-redirect.sh && API=http://localhost:3001/api/v1 RD=http://localhost:3002 DATABASE_URL=postgres://snapurl:snapurl@localhost:5435/snapurl bash scripts/integration-assertions.sh
scripts.staging:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml down -v && (bash scripts/staging-prune.sh || true)
